data.desc: SAMFINE CREATION HOLDINGS GROUP LIMITED is an established one-stop printing service provider which principally provides printing services in Hong Kong and the PRC. With over 20 years of experience in the printing industry, its operating subsidiaries offer a wide range of printed products such as book products, novelty and packaging products. Its operating subsidiaries' customers principally comprise of book traders located in Hong Kong whose clients are located around the world, mainly in the U.S. and Europe.
